}}'''Farming''' is a tier two [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Farm]], a [[building]] that costs five [[stars]], provides two [[population]], and can only be built on tiles with crop. 

For the [[Cymanti]] [[tribe]], Farming unlocks the [[Fungi]], a building whose population produced grows over time, instead of the Farm. 

[[Zebasi]] and [[Cymanti]] start with Farming.
